const inserted = context.workflow['PARSE']?.result?.portfolio
if (!inserted?.id) return []
function defaultContentForType(typeKey) {
  const map = {
    profile: { name: 'Your name', bio: 'A short introduction about you.', location: 'City, Country', avatar_url: '' },
    project: { title: 'Featured project', eyebrow: 'Project', description: 'What you built and why it matters.', url: '', image_url: '' },
    stat: { number: '99', label: 'Score', supporting: '' },
    applying_to: { institution_1: 'Dream University', institution_2: '', institution_3: '', status: 'Applying 2026' },
    awards: { name: 'Award name', organisation: 'Organisation', year: '2025', icon: '🏆' },
    hobby: { name: 'Piano', detail: 'Grade 8', icon: '🎹' },
    quote: { text: 'A quote that inspires you.', author: 'Author', source: '' },
    activities: { items: [{ name: 'Math Olympiad', detail: '' }, { name: 'Robotics Club', detail: '' }] },
    links: { items: [{ label: 'LinkedIn', url: '' }, { label: 'GitHub', url: '' }] },
    city: { city: 'Singapore', country: '', image_url: '' }
  }
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(map[typeKey] || { title: 'New tile' }))
}
const TYPE_NAMES = { profile: 'Profile', project: 'Project', stat: 'Stat', applying_to: 'Applying To', awards: 'Awards', hobby: 'Hobby', quote: 'Quote', activities: 'Activities', links: 'Links', city: 'City' }
const STARTER_TILES = [
  { tile_type: 'profile', grid_column: 1, grid_row: 1, column_span: 1, row_span: 2, sort_order: 1, colour_key: 'sakura' },
  { tile_type: 'project', grid_column: 2, grid_row: 1, column_span: 2, row_span: 2, sort_order: 2, colour_key: 'white' },
  { tile_type: 'stat', grid_column: 4, grid_row: 1, column_span: 1, row_span: 1, sort_order: 3, colour_key: 'mist' },
  { tile_type: 'applying_to', grid_column: 2, grid_row: 3, column_span: 2, row_span: 1, sort_order: 4, colour_key: 'moss' },
  { tile_type: 'awards', grid_column: 4, grid_row: 2, column_span: 1, row_span: 1, sort_order: 5, colour_key: 'butter' },
  { tile_type: 'hobby', grid_column: 4, grid_row: 3, column_span: 1, row_span: 1, sort_order: 6, colour_key: 'sakura' },
  { tile_type: 'quote', grid_column: 1, grid_row: 3, column_span: 1, row_span: 1, sort_order: 7, colour_key: 'white' },
  { tile_type: 'activities', grid_column: 2, grid_row: 4, column_span: 2, row_span: 1, sort_order: 8, colour_key: 'mist' },
  { tile_type: 'links', grid_column: 1, grid_row: 4, column_span: 1, row_span: 1, sort_order: 9, colour_key: 'moss' },
  { tile_type: 'city', grid_column: 4, grid_row: 4, column_span: 1, row_span: 1, sort_order: 10, colour_key: 'white' }
]
return STARTER_TILES.map((spec, i) => ({
  portfolio_id: inserted.id,
  tile_type: spec.tile_type,
  title: TYPE_NAMES[spec.tile_type] || spec.tile_type,
  content: defaultContentForType(spec.tile_type),
  colour_key: spec.colour_key,
  grid_column: spec.grid_column,
  grid_row: spec.grid_row,
  column_span: spec.column_span,
  row_span: spec.row_span,
  sort_order: spec.sort_order || i + 1,
  is_visible: true
}))
